helpers.note: Knuth's error-free sum of two doubles into a double-double, arithmetic of the engine's model of the x87 fsin/fcos result (java8::series); neither Minecraft nor the JDK has such a method
Dekker's fast two-sum (|a| >= |b|) into a double-double, renormalisation for the engine's x87 model of Java 8 Math.sin/cos; no vanilla or JDK counterpart
Veltkamp split of a double into two 26-bit halves for Dekker's exact product, part of the engine's double-double arithmetic; no vanilla or JDK counterpart
Dekker's exact product of two doubles as a double-double (no fma), double-double arithmetic of the engine's x87 model; no vanilla or JDK counterpart
double-double times double-double, used by the Taylor series that models the x87 fsin/fcos value; no vanilla or JDK counterpart
double-double divided by a small double (the series' k(k+1) denominators); engine double-double arithmetic with no vanilla or JDK counterpart
1 - a in double-double, a Horner step of the engine's series for the x87 value; no vanilla or JDK counterpart

whether an engine ProjectileKind is an AbstractArrow family (arrow, spectral, tipped, trident), a match on the engine enum standing in for Java's class hierarchy; no method

from_name returning None instead of the Generic fallback for an unknown name; input validation of the engine API
copies a ProjectileState's position, motion and flags into the engine's ProjectileTickResult; a result struct vanilla does not have

copies the ArrowState fields an arrow tick changed back into the TridentState; the inverse of arrow, engine type plumbing with no vanilla counterpart
builds the engine's TridentTickResult from an ArrowTickResult and the trident's state; a result struct vanilla does not have

copies an internal BlockHit into the public ProjectileBlockHit of the report; engine result plumbing
appends a ProjectileEntityHit to the tick's report; the engine's output of what vanilla does to the target, not a vanilla method
maps a caller's registry name to the engine's MovingEntityKind / MobTravelKind enum; a binding input lookup
constructs the engine's MovingEntityState with client authority and zeroed counters (fuse 80 as a starting default); an engine state struct, no vanilla constructor is mirrored
returns the state with MovingEntityAuthority::Server; a builder of the engine's client/server choice, which vanilla expresses as level.isClientSide

copies a SimulationState's position, motion, box and flags back into the MovingEntityState after a move; conversion between engine types
takes the next caller-supplied random float, counting use and flagging a missing draw (0.0); the engine's input stream for vanilla's random.nextFloat(), not a vanilla method
